tests: Large PR (300 KB diff). A read-then-write on proposalKey races two creates into a 500; one production run on this commit caught it, another approved. The author fixed it.
Production flagged a sync background task as blocking the event loop. Starlette runs sync background tasks in a threadpool; the author refuted it. Nothing to block.
dbt re-review with one prior. Production claimed ZIP+4 suffixes lose leading zeros; the author showed the column is a string. Nothing to block.
Small money-path change. A transient Vercel error on the last poll attempt strands a paid domain purchase. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
Medium Serve PR. A person who replied to two sends is counted twice per channel. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
A GitHub Actions workflow interpolates a PR comment body into a shell script. Production caught the injection; the author fixed it.
A person's own profile photo overrides a takedown on two card types. Production raised both; the author fixed both.
Dependabot bumps maplibre-gl two majors in package.json only. Tests how a reviewer handles a dependency PR with almost no diff.
Bugbot called the ECR Public login region a High bug; amazon-ecr-login hardcodes us-east-1 for public logins. Production approved, correctly.
Docs-only: where agent experiment runs can work. Production approved.
Re-review after the author fixed both prior findings (SUPERSEDED missing from an exclusion and its test). Production approved.
The CRM entry to the Campaign Manager greets every user without their first name. Production caught it; the author fixed it.

Two production runs on this commit disagreed: one approved, one caught that hasInternalOwner skips every free-robocall eligibility rule for an owner whose email ends in @goodparty.org, an email the user can set through PUT /v1/users/me.

The task definition reads the gateway config by its SSM parameter ARN, which does not change when the value does, so a config.json edit never reaches a running task. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
A tighter ALB health check fails a migrating boot after about 30s, and the ECS service has no healthCheckGracePeriod, so startPeriod does not cover it. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
With no deploymentConfiguration, a desiredCount 1 service starts a second Bifrost task before stopping the first, breaking the single-node assumption. Production caught it; the author fixed it.

The hold-model cancel reads the send's status, then deletes the Peerly job and releases the hold with no CAS, so an approve landing in between is cancelled under it. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
The funding reconcile picks unpaid sends by updatedAt in the last 24 hours, so an unfunded send nobody touches again is reported once and then never. Production caught it; the author fixed it.
The page body moved to officeDisplayName, but all eight generateMetadata functions still title the page with the raw position name. Production caught it; the author fixed it.

The all-options-ticked rule uses the family's column count, but the age family holds two band sets, so an audience ticking every band of one set reads as filtered. Production caught it; the author confirmed it in the data and fixed it.

Production flagged the SMS cutoff ignoring primary-only campaigns. The rule counts only the general election date, matching smsComplianceWindow in eligibility.util.ts; the author refuted it. Nothing to block.

Production flagged an ICP flag returning false instead of null for a position missing from the seed. A missing seed row means the position is off the allow list, so false is correct; the author refuted it. Nothing to block.

Production flagged the legal-caution backstop running on a draft-step clarify turn. The clarifying question travels in tool arguments and the streamed text is one short lead-in, so the line cannot land on it; the author refuted it. Nothing to block.
Two prior findings. Production failed: the model mangled a prior finding's UUID and the whole output failed the schema.
Same two prior findings one push later. Production carried both forward onto their existing threads.
One prior finding that was fixed. Production failed: the model ended on prose about the prior finding and returned no JSON.
One prior test-coverage finding the push addressed. Production failed: the model stopped mid-check of the prior finding with no JSON.
One prior cross-file finding. Production failed: the model returned fenced JSON the parser could not use.
Three prior findings across three files, all still open, on a diff too large to inline. Production carried all three.
Two prior findings in a dbt repo. Production carried one and raised one new finding.
Two prior findings in different files. Production carried one and dropped the other as fixed.
Four prior findings in one file, all fixed. Production approved with no findings.
One prior security finding the model raised again one line away without linking it, so production opened a duplicate thread.
